description: Hand a working session between this agent and bamf.ai. direction=to_bamf stores a context packet (goal, decisions, open_steps, recent_turns, notes) into the linked bamf.ai chat (pass external_session_id, or agent_session_id) and returns its URL so the user can continue there. direction=from_bamf returns the packet and recent turns for a bamf.ai chat (agent_session_id) so you can continue it here. Never sends messages or posts.

external_session_id.description: This client's session id (to_bamf without agent_session_id).

name: bamf.handoff_session
